title: Move agent file tools onto the computer-capable host
description:
**Step 3 of the accepted `chatticus-fccc4e9a` host-disk plan.** Steps 1 (`chatticus-4ac60c71`) and 2 (`chatticus-47533582` / PR #321) are closed.

Move agent file tools off the in-process `computer.workspace` dict and onto the summoned computer-capable host (a workspace executor beside `ChromiumActionExecutor`). One path: do not leave the dict readable beside host disk.

Gherkin, worker, Front Door HTTP. Host is `HttpWorkerPlane` only. File bytes live on `ComputerHostDisk`; ThinTurn recycle must not drop them from the agent-visible path.

**Not this slice:** customer snapshot bucket / `customer-role.yml` (`chatticus-bb908488` is step 4). Gherkin may use `FilesystemSnapshotStore`. No `/workspace` EFS. No prompt tuning.

## Done when

Agent file read/write is specified in Gherkin against host disk (not the dict), green through the Front Door host path. `ControlPlane.read_workspace` / `write_workspace` are no longer the agent-visible workplace. No `customer-role.yml` edit.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Plan reviewed and **authorized** with holes closed.

Worktree verified: `/tmp/chatticus-5ac06b-file-tools-host` on `feat/5ac06b-file-tools-on-host` (HEAD `bf13e95`, not the primary clone). One path: host `WorkspaceActionExecutor` on `ComputerHostDisk`; computerless file tools escalate; dict is not an agent-visible reader. No `customer-role.yml` / `chatticus-bb9084`. Front Door HTTP on the host.

**Closed on authorize:**
1. **Deny before summon.** Ungranted paths must fail in computerless **before** `prepare_computer_tool` / `ensure_computer` / host start. `prepare_computer_tool` always `ensure_computer` today.
2. **`write_workspace` is a model tool in this slice**, not executor-only. Add it to the OpenAI tool schema and Gherkin, same as `read_workspace`.
3. **First summon** uses kernel `enqueue_computer_continuation`. Do not `POST …/turns/{id}/resume` while the computer is stopped (`ComputerNotReadyError`).
4. **Do not rewrite `computer_snapshots.feature`** protocol dict/`_snapshots` bridge. Agent-visible I/O must not use `computer.workspace`.
5. **Gherkin is the behavior gate** for escalation, host execute, grant-deny-without-start. Do not keep duplicate pytest stories in `test_model_tool_loop_sinks.py`. Pytest stays for `workspace_paths` (and similar pure helpers).
6. **Store unset:** file tools still read/write `CHATTICUS_LIVE_ROOT`. `HostActionExecutor` constructs `ComputerHostDisk` from `live_root_from_env()`; missing snapshot store must not crash writes.
7. **Grant check in `prepare_computer_tool`** for file-tool paths (same moment browse origins are checked), so a pending call is never committed without a grant.

Tear the worktree down only after the manager closes the issue.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/322 **request changes**. Do not merge.

In-process acceptance PASS does not override this.

1. Grant-deny Gherkin must assert **no computer continuation job** (and turn not waiting on workspace), not only that the computer is still stopped. Both `computer_host_workspace_executor.feature` and `model_tool_loop_sinks.feature` denial scenarios.
2. Host must re-gate file-tool paths before execute, matching `_regate_committed_browse_url`. A fenced handoff with an ungranted path must not write/read host disk.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Closed.** Step 3 landed on `develop` as `6494526` / PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/322.

Agent `read_workspace` / `write_workspace` run on the summoned host (`ComputerHostDisk`). Computerless grant-checks before summon, escalates via `enqueue_computer_continuation`, waits on `workspace`. Host re-gates file paths before execute. Control-plane dict raises `WorkspaceHostOnlyError` for agent I/O (`seed_snapshot_workspace` remains protocol-only).

Worktree `/tmp/chatticus-5ac06b-file-tools-host` to be removed by the implementer. Next is step 4: `chatticus-bb908488` (customer snapshot bucket in the published template).
